Class Fleet

java.lang.Object
com.example.software_meth_3_javafx.util.List<Vehicle>
com.example.software_meth_3_javafx.fleet.Fleet
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Vehicle>
public class Fleet extends List<Vehicle>
This class creates a dynamic array of Vehicle objects that allows to add, remove, find, and a print sorted by make (then obtained date).
Author:
Carly Chick
